name: Haley Hasho
photo_alt: Haley Hasho, real estate agent, in a black blazer with her arms crossed.
headline: Explore Haley Hasho's Expertise in New York City Real Estate
bio_html:
Haley Hasho founded Exodus Capital in early 2022. Originally from Oyster Bay, New York, her career in real estate began at an off-market boutique firm in Manhattan after spending time at Citibank. She was then recruited by Marcus & Millichap and was the only female agent to join the #1 top producing brokerage team in New York City. Haley was awarded Marcus & Millichap’s Manhattan “Rising Star of 2020," was the recipient of Commercial Observer’s “Top Young Sales Professionals of 2021," and 2022 Former Manhattan Borough President "Stanley M. Isaac’s Award," and a "Top 25 Female Nominee of 2023" for WomELLE's magazine. Her transactions have been featured in The New York Times, Commercial Observer, The Real Deal, The New York Real Estate Journal, and various other publications. Her team has executed on $125M of real estate from launch of her company.

 

Haley focuses on mid-market seller representation across the boroughs and is well versed in the city housing laws. Throughout her career she has personally sold over $300,000,000 of real estate. Most recently, she was responsible for the 348-unit estate sale of two-time Pulitzer Prize winning author of The Power Broker, Robert Caro. The portfolio consisted of 6 properties across the Upper East, Upper West, Bronx, Washington Heights and Queens for $85,600,000. Some of her other notable transactions include a same day contract sign + close of a corner mixed-use building on 81st + Amsterdam for $17,000,000 during the height of COVID. 

 

She attended the University of Richmond, Stanford, and Oxford, where she was a public speaking coach and award-winning Mock Trial competitor, ultimately graduating with honors in Rhetoric + Law. She is actively involved in New York Young Republicans (NYYR), CHIP (Community Housing Improvement Program,) multiple Jewish organizations and is the founder of a Ladies Landlord Taste Testing Series. 

 

Haley is a formerly trained classical ballerina and pianist, enjoys visits to her family in Charleston and a good game of chess.

name: Joey Mohsen
photo_alt: Joey Mohsen in glasses and a navy suit with arms crossed.
headline: Explore Brooklyn's Top Commercial Real Estate Agent
bio_html:
Originally from Rockland County, Joey Mohsen is a dynamic entrepreneur with a proven track record of success across multiple industries. He began his career as a commercial plumbing laborer while still in high school before transitioning into the high-end custom jewelry retail space, where he generated over $10,000,000 in sales from 2020 to 2022. During this time, Joey also owned and operated American & Spanish fusion food trucks in the Bronx and Manhattan, ultimately selling the business for a six-figure profit in a short period.
 
Behind the scenes, Joey was actively involved in fixing and flipping properties, an experience that naturally led him into commercial real estate. With a passion for the industry from a young age, he joined Exodus Capital in 2022 as the company’s first hire. His entrepreneurial problem-solving skills quickly set him apart, and within just 18 months, he closed over $20,000,000 in sales across Manhattan and Brooklyn. Many of these deals were one-off specialty-use transactions, achieving exceptionally high prices for his clients. Some of his most notable transactions include 312 Atlantic Avenue to a Chinese food emporium developer, 1134 First Avenue to a Los Angeles clothing designer, and 425 Court Street to a laundromat operator. 
 
Joey continues to scale his success at Exodus, surpassing $40,000,000 in total sales, with a primary focus on Brooklyn and Rockland County.
 
In addition to real estate, Joey actively runs a wholesale jewelry company since 2024, which has already achieved seven figures in sales. He has recently also expanded his real estate acquisitions business at the start of 2025 and is on pace to purchase 10 properties by year-end.
 
Beyond his professional endeavors, Joey has roots in Damascus, Syria, and enjoys spending quality time with his family. He is fluent in Arabic and a passionate baseball fan.

name: Ben Wiles
headline: Explore Luxury Real Estate with Ben Wiles
bio_html:
Meet Benjamin Wiles, he started off his career as a welder at Westendorf Manufacturing out of high school and moved to Iowa to pursue arc welding for tractor parts and excavators. After many months of coming home covered in metal dust and burns, he decided to pivot and spend time as a bartender and jeweler in Sioux City before deciding to move back to New York where he began his journey in real estate.
 
He began his career at RE/MAX Town & County and joined the Howard Payson Team in Fishkill where he focused on selling homes in Westchester, Putnam and Dutchess. While working there for a year as a residential agent, he decided to segue into the commercial real estate sector to join the Exodus Capital team. 
 
In his spare time, Benjamin enjoys fishing, going to the gym and spending time with his family.

name: Vik Agrawal
headline: Explore Commercial Real Estate with Vik Agrawal
bio_html:
Meet Vik Agrawal, a proud native of North Potomac, Maryland. Armed with a Bachelor's degree in Business from the University of Texas at Austin and a Masters in Finance from George Washington University, Vik has honed his skills and expertise in the realm of commercial real estate.

Driven by a profound passion for real estate and an astute eye for investment opportunities, Vik specializes in facilitating commercial real estate transactions. With a keen understanding of market trends, property valuation, and negotiation strategies, he is committed to delivering exceptional service and tangible results within the commercial real estate community.

Beyond his professional pursuits, Vik finds joy in various activities. Whether he's hitting the sports field, embarking on new travel adventures, or indulging in the latest culinary delights.
